description.value:
Your wristpad channels powers drawn from technical schematics, following the general techcasting rules and the tech powers list.

Tech Powers Known. You start knowing 3 tech powers of your choice, learning more at higher levels per the Tech Powers Known column of the Saboteur Practice Techcasting table. You can't learn a power whose level exceeds your current Max Power Level.

Tech Points. Your pool of tech points equals half your operative level (per the Tech Points column of the table) plus your Intelligence modifier. Casting a tech power spends these points, and you regain them all on finishing a short or long rest.

Max Power Level. Some tech powers can be overcharged, spending extra points for a stronger effect, up to a ceiling that rises with level per the Max Power Level column. You can only overcharge a power to 4th level once between long rests.

Techcasting Ability. Intelligence governs your tech powers; use it whenever a power references your techcasting ability, and for setting both your save DC and attack bonus with tech powers.

Tech save DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Intelligence modifier

Tech attack modifier = your proficiency bonus + your Intelligence modifier

Techcasting Focus. You use a wristpad as your techcasting focus.
